summary: Iteration 4 dual-environment cTrader refactor verification (backend + frontend). The refactor itself is SOUND: both live and demo clients boot, connect over separate persistent WebSockets and authenticate at Spotware; the boot log contains '[cTrader.Client] Dual-env clients ready: main=live, alt=demo'; /api/ctrader/connection/status exposes environments.live.state=AUTHENTICATED AND environments.demo.state=AUTHENTICATED; /api/ctrader/diagnostics returns diagnostics.host=live.ctraderapi.com AND diagnosticsAlt.host=demo.ctraderapi.com. No circular imports, no boot errors, and all @ptsmiea baseline numbers are UNCHANGED (191 trades, winRate 49.2, realizedPnL -1117.30). Frontend feed renders 8 position-progress-bar elements and the socket.io WebSocket upgrades to HTTP 101 and joins the user room when a session exists. Dashboard Portfolio regression passes exactly ('Portofolio (191)' + 'Halaman 1 / 10 - 1-20 dari 191'). HOWEVER the headline user-facing goal (real-time price/pips/profit movement on live AND demo) could NOT be verified and is currently non-functional in this environment: there is NO cTrader OAuth broker session left in MongoDB (all 3 users have ctrader_connected=false, ctrader_access_token=null, ctrader_accounts=[]), so zero trading accounts are re-authenticated on either client, zero symbols get subscribed, and every feed post is a CLOSED deal. Additionally no admin user exists in the DB at all, so the @Master_Reverdal admin+DEMO path is entirely unexercised. New tests: 28 passed / 1 skipped. Full backend suite: 78 passed / 7 failed (5 of the 7 are stale iteration-1 shard tests, config drifted to CTRADER_SHARD_COUNT=1).

critical.issue: No broker account is re-authenticated on boot on EITHER client. db_store.users has 3 users, all with ctrader_connected=false / ctrader_access_token=null / ctrader_accounts=[], so live_tasks and demo_tasks are both empty and the new '[cTrader.Restore] Scheduled N live + M demo' log line has NEVER been emitted (grep count = 0 across the whole backend log). Consequence: connection/status authenticated_accounts=[] and environments.live.accounts=0, environments.demo.accounts=0 -> ticker.subscribe_symbol() has nothing to resolve -> no ProtoOASpotEvent ever arrives -> price/pips/profitUSD cannot move on live OR demo. The dual-env architecture is correct but has zero live data flowing through it.

Root cause candidate: when the access token expires and no ctrader_refresh_token is stored, the code silently does update_user({'ctrader_connected': False}) and returns False. Combined with /api/ctrader/token/status now reporting hasAccessToken=false/hasRefreshToken=false while still returning expiresAt=2026-10-01, @ptsmiea's session was wiped with no user-visible error and no recovery path. Needs re-connect of the broker account (and a refresh-token persistence fix) before realtime can be validated at all.

minor.issue: Data consistency: for many XAUUSD CLOSED posts profitUSD does not match lot x price move derived from entryPrice/currentPrice (e.g. 0.01 lot move -4.42 -> profitUSD -8.96 (~2x); 0.1 lot move -2.27 -> profitUSD -233.00 (~10x)). Means currentPrice on closed posts is not the actual close price, so the PositionProgressBar NOW marker position disagrees with the P/L shown on the same card. Fails tests/test_ptsmiea_ctrader.py::TestFeedNumbers::test_profit_consistent_with_lot_and_pips.

CTraderClient has no get_shards_summary(), so with CTRADER_SHARD_COUNT=1 the endpoint falls into the synthetic branch and returns shardCount=1 with authScheduler={} and mongoWriter={} (empty observability), and the shard_assignments collection holds 0 lease docs. 5 stale iteration-1 tests in tests/test_ctrader_shards.py expect 8 shards + populated authScheduler/mongoWriter. Decide whether sharding is retired (then delete those tests) or restore the metrics.
Both return 404 Not Found (routes do not exist). Not a regression, but worth confirming the frontend does not call them.

ui_bugs.issue: No literal 'NOW' label is rendered. Reference layout in the request expects SL/Entry/NOW/TP; actual DOM renders SL (8), Entry (16), TP (8) and 'PRICE 4083.23' in place of NOW (0 occurrences). The floating '% Position' badge with glow IS present on all 8 cards and looks correct. Cosmetic deviation from the reference only.

Portfolio rows use a dynamic per-trade testid (data-testid=`portfolio-trade-${t.id}`) with no stable container/row-class testid, so automation cannot count rows generically. 20 rows do render correctly (verified visually).

integration_issues.issue: UNVERIFIABLE / currently dead end-to-end. (a) No broker account authenticated on either env so no spot events are produced at all; (b) DynamicFeedTemplate only subscribes to livePositionStore when (rawTrade.status === 'OPEN' && isIntersecting) (L181-214) and all 8 feed posts are status=CLOSED, so even if ticks arrived no card would update. Captured 2 samples 3s and 6s apart on the first card: bar text identical both times ('SELL / PRICE 4083.23 / -0.20% Position'). Socket transport itself is healthy: wss://.../socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket opened, frames = handshake sid, 40{"userId":"user-ptsmiea"}, 40 ack, 42["join:user_room"], and console logged '[SocketClient] Connected ...'.

socketClient.connect() is only called when currentUser?.id is truthy (App.tsx L429-436), so a public visitor gets NO socket.io connection at all (only the CRA HMR socket wss://.../?token=... was observed). Public feed therefore never receives live updates. Confirm this is intended.

Story rail at the top is horizontally clipped mid-avatar at the right edge of the narrow column with no visible scroll affordance.

critical_code_review_comments: ctrader_client.py L1195-1212: when CTRADER_SHARD_COUNT>1, ctrader_client becomes a ShardManager built WITHOUT an env argument while ctrader_client_alt is always a plain single CTraderClient — the dual-env design is asymmetric and untested in sharded mode. ShardManager also exposes account_states/account_to_user_map as @property, which the new find_account_state/find_user_for_account helpers read via getattr(c,'account_states',{}); that happens to work but resolve_client_for_env compares getattr(ctrader_client,'_env',_MAIN_ENV) and ShardManager has no _env, so it silently relies on the default. Add an explicit env param to ShardManager and a test for shard_count>1.

ctrader_config.get_ctrader_env() defaults to 'demo' when CTRADER_ENVIRONMENT is unset — this silently FLIPS main/alt clients (reproduced: importing ctrader_client without loading /app/backend/.env yields main=demo, alt=live). Make the env explicit/required or default to 'live' so a missing var cannot invert live and demo routing.

server.py on_startup L290-323 iterates db_store.users only; there is no verification that the restore actually authenticated anything and no log on the zero-task path, which is exactly how the current total restore failure went unnoticed.
server.py is 4047 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; split the cTrader routes, feed routes and auth routes into separate routers.

server.py L1825-1866: the /api/ctrader/shards/status fallback returns authScheduler={} and mongoWriter={} instead of a 501/explicit 'sharding disabled' marker, so a dead observability path looks like a successful 200 response.

rca_of_the_issue: The dual-env refactor is not the cause of the realtime failure. Root cause of 'prices do not move': there is no persisted cTrader OAuth session in MongoDB. All three user documents (user-ptsmiea, user-mr_sofyan51, user-test_qa_1788359938) have ctrader_connected=false, ctrader_access_token=null and ctrader_accounts=[]. Reproduction: (1) query users collection -> no user has a token; (2) GET /api/ctrader/token/status -> isConnected=false, hasAccessToken=false, hasRefreshToken=false; (3) grep '[cTrader.Restore]' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log -> 0 hits, i.e. the new restore code produced zero tasks; (4) the last ProtoOAAccountAuthRes lines in the log are dated 2026-08-31, none in the current 2026-09-03 boot; (5) GET /api/ctrader/connection/status -> authenticated_accounts=[] and both environments report accounts=0; (6) POST /api/ctrader/switch with 48005582 -> 400 ACCOUNT_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Because no account is authenticated, ticker never issues a spot subscription, so ProtoOASpotEvent never fires and livePositionStore.dispatchUpdate is never called; the UI is correct but starved of input. The likely trigger is server.py L993: on token expiry with no stored refresh token the code silently sets ctrader_connected=False and returns False, permanently dropping the session. Mitigation: persist ctrader_refresh_token on OAuth callback, re-run the OAuth connect for @ptsmiea, add an explicit warning log plus a zero-task restore log, then re-run the realtime verification for both live and demo (and seed an admin user with a DEMO account for the @Master_Reverdal path).
